summary: A detailed trust matrix can create administrative confidence while compound actions, stale evidence, and enforcement gaps remain.

points.text: The state space grows quickly across models, versions, tools, resources, tenants, and task classes. Unmaintained cells silently become permissive defaults or block legitimate work.
Safe-looking permissions can compose into harm: reading instructions, writing a configuration file, and triggering an otherwise approved job may together bypass an intended execution ban.

Content guardrails have false positives and false negatives, and indirect prompt injection can cross a permitted read channel into a permitted action. Enforcement must reason about provenance and data flow, not only action names.
Overly restrictive policies drive users toward shared credentials, manual copying, or unlogged side channels, reducing observability and sometimes increasing actual risk.
